name: transport_authenticity-does-not-prove-truth-or-completeness
established: authenticated channel and receiver-side peer verification
not_established: payload facts are truthful or complete

name: event_byte_integrity-does-not-prove-truth-or-completeness
established: canonicalization plus signature, MAC, or hash verification
not_established: correctness of pre-signing state or timestamp

name: storage_integrity-does-not-prove-truth-or-completeness
established: access controls, immutable storage, checksums, and attestation

name: completeness-does-not-prove-truth-or-completeness
established: bounded reconciliation against independent authoritative sequence/outbox

name: ordering-does-not-prove-truth-or-completeness
not_established: global causal or wall-clock total order

name: truthful_application_state-does-not-prove-truth-or-completeness
established: independent state reconciliation and trustworthy producer logic

name: non_repudiation-does-not-prove-truth-or-completeness
established: legal identity key-control process outside this contract
not_established: legal non-repudiation from contract conformance alone
